title: Something About You
description:
Because of a difficult family background, Ji-U enters college later than most of her peers. Quiet and reserved, she keeps to the edges of campus life, always feeling one step out of sync with everyone else. There is one person she cannot help noticing, U-Yeon, a boy who seems to shine wherever he goes. He stands at the center of every group, laughing easily, drawing people in without effort. Compared to him, Ji-U feels invisible, and so she hides her feelings, nursing a silent crush she believes will never reach him. To Ji-U, U-Yeon appears flawless, someone untouched by hardship or pain. But one rainy day, that illusion shatters. Ji-U stumbles upon U-Yeon standing alone in the downpour, tears mixing with rain as he cries with heartbreaking beauty. In that moment, Ji-U realizes that even the brightest people carry unseen scars. And perhaps her quiet presence could become a place of comfort for him.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

description:

title: Winter Field
description:
At the edge of a distant continent, a land perpetually blanketed in snow lies Oldenland, ruled by Archduke Giesel Zvendard. His cold demeanor, overwhelming magical prowess, and even the bizarre rumor that he carries the blood of monsters make everyone fear him. Yet few know that what Giesel truly desires is simply a peaceful daily life, immersed in magical research with a warm cup of tea in his quiet study. What shattered this modest wish was an unexpected bride from the southernmost tip of Cornia. Rensley Mallosen, the bastard son of Cornia, appeared wearing a bride's crown in place of his runaway sister. His brief attempt to hide, fearing discovery, was short-lived. This cheerful, chatty knight, his sun-like golden hair flowing as he roamed the castle, kept stirring up small disturbances in the ice castle that seemed destined for eternal silence. Even though he should have been driven out immediately for this fraudulent marriage, Giesel found himself increasingly unable to look away from Rensley, who beamed brightly and chattered away at even the smallest kindness. Rensley, who had been rejected from the moment he was born and ultimately abandoned, arriving in Oldenland, began to harbor affection for Giesel's seemingly indifferent yet kind demeanor. But the moment he became aware of his feelings, the time for parting drew near...

To Oldenland, the coldest land on the continent, yet where the warmest things gather, will Rensley ever be able to return?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: The Forgotten Field
description:
*"I pray every day that this love dies, that I may love you only until today, and that tomorrow this love will be dead."*

Thalia Roem Gürta, the ill-fated princess born of an affair. She grows up distorted amidst indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings, and servants who despise her. Thalia has protected herself by raising her thorns against everyone who approaches. Yet, even she becomes defenseless in the presence of one person. He is none other than the Prince of the East, Varkas Raedgo Sheerkan. Forced to be perfect as a retainer of the imperial court and the heir to the Grand Duke, he grew up with most of his emotions numb under discipline bordering on abuse. A man who exists solely for the honor and duty of his family. To keep a promise made to the late Empress, he enters into a marriage with Thalia's half-sister, Ayla, and Thalia, engulfed in despair, slowly falls apart. However, her love, destined for death, faces an unexpected turning point....

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: Collage
description:
*In a season when cherry blossom petals scatter on the dry wind, I fell in love with a pale faced poet. My first experience of unrequited love was like a fever.
Each time I suffered from it, I caught my heated breath and quietly sank into misery. Yet that spring was undeniably the most lyrical season of my life.*

Baek Seonghyeon, a poor working student, returns to university with a completely ruined timetable after getting the course registration date wrong. Forced to attend even a literature class he has no interest in, he looks up the course withdrawal period and happens to notice a note taking job posting on campus. Twice a week, a monthly pay of 1.5 million won. Without a second thought, Baek Seonghyeon sends in his application.

Never once imagining that there, he would meet a poet who would completely upend his life.

description:
Doh Hyeonwoo is an elite "hound" deployed deep into the criminal underworld to dismantle the Black Cloud Tribe, a ruthless syndicate tearing the city's order apart. While his infiltration goes smoothly at first, his mission hits a bizarre roadblock in the form of a man known simply as Mr. Ha. For some reason, this erratic superior interferes with Hyeonwoo’s every move, constantly disrupting the operation. Desperate to maintain his cover, Hyeonwoo defends himself: 

*"I told you, I’m just a Beta!"*

But Mr. Ha merely leans in close, a dangerous smirk on his lips.

*"That’s strange. Then why do you smell so incredibly sweet?"*

With Mr. Ha ruthlessly invading his personal space and hunting for his hidden scent, Hyeonwoo's vital undercover operation begins to unravel in the most chaotic, intoxicating way possible.

title: Jongmalbyeonggi
description:
Born from the weaponization of nuclear fusion technology, the superhuman weapons known as Defiers (D-fire) plunged the world into war—an apocalypse that wiped out 30% of humanity. The survivors came to loathe the Defiers, branding them the architects of extinction and calling them “Enders.”Theo, the sole survivor among the Enders, lived for 30 years under the surveillance of the Ainex Alliance, his core removed, passing his days as an ordinary family man. But when the anti-nuclear terrorist organization “Zero Core” attacks, Theo loses his wife—and his daughter Louise vanishes without a trace. The peace he struggled to protect is shattered in an instant.Vowing revenge, Theo reawakens the forbidden power he sealed away three decades ago to reclaim his daughter. Standing against Zero Core’s vast conspiracy and a world steeped in prejudice, the lonely battle of the last Ender begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

description:

“Mr. Lee Hyunmuk, you can’t kill me, okay? I’m… human….”
“Human….”
“That’s right, I’m human…. And you are too, Mr. Lee Hyunmuk.”

But Hyunmuk, influenced by the Abyss, is half-mad. Together with him - who only occasionally regains his senses - Yohan struggles to survive, treating wounds and searching for food.

“This place experiences a certain phenomenon once every few decades. I call it a ‘flood.’”
“A flood?”
“As it approaches, the corruption and madness grow worse… just like I was a moment ago.”

But when the sudden onset of a flood hits, Hyunmuk completely loses his mind…

“If you’re a lamb, why don’t you bleat?”

“My lamb.”

In the brutal environment of the Abyss, with a festering leg wound, terrifying monsters that howl and attack - and on top of that, Hyunmuk’s madness... Yohan’s desperate struggle to escape this otherworld leaves him not a day without tears.

description:
Ever since he became Tae-geon’s boyfriend, Yoo-an has been plagued by anxiety every day. Eventually, he manages to confine Tae-geon… But then, Tae-geon—who had always been so mature and gentle—began to reveal his true colors.

Taegon replied with a gentle smile, showing little sign of being the one who had just been locked up.

*“Then… if I show you the side of me I’ve been hiding for fear you might dislike it, would that put your mind at ease?”*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

unknown.title: The Day We Cross the Line

description:
A longtime veteran at Seonam City Hall, stuck in a never ending slump, a washed up athlete on the verge of retirement. Ji Haeyoung. Despite enduring endless malicious comments, Haeyoung stubbornly keeps the national team badge on his chest and competes in the Winter Olympics.

*[“Hyung, you know… if I get first place, can I show you my face? Not just first place, but world number one. At the biggest competition.”]*

For a brief moment, Haeyoung is filled with anticipation at the thought of seeing again the cute little kid he met long ago.

*“Can you not go a single day without a man? You even went as far as fucking some foreign guy, fuck. You’re not even a rag, you’re worse….”*

That kid has grown into an arrogant genius athlete constantly surrounded by personality controversies.

*“Hey, isn’t this a bit much? Going straight to your room like this?”*  
*“What’s so wrong about it? You think it’s fine for you to get off by yourself? After you turned me into this?”*  
*“When did I ever do that, mmph!”*

A scorching night that passes like an accident. Even as Haeyoung feels guilty toward Juho, who does not recognize him, he finds himself growing increasingly drawn to him.

*“Gong Juho. Want to try dating…?”*  
*“You made a good choice. There’s no one better than me.”*

Haeyoung thinks they are dating, while Juho believes they are just sex partners. Thus begins a relationship where they dream different dreams.

*“Yeah. It’s not that I want to have sex with hyung… it’s just that it pisses me off seeing a man who looks like hyung spreading himself for anyone right in front of me. I just want to stop it, at least during the Olympics.”*

Juho, too, forcefully suppresses his confusion and does everything he can to satisfy Haeyoung.

Will the two of them be able to safely reclaim both the gold medal and their past connection?

description:
Jihye has been able to see beings she was never supposed to see since childhood, and even now as an adult working an office job, she lives through precarious days, never knowing when danger might strike. Then one day, on her way home after catching her boyfriend of nine years cheating and breaking up with him, Jihye happens to meet a dokkaebi who is wandering in search of the Mountain Spirit. The dokkaebi makes her an offer: if she helps him find the Mountain Spirit, he will fix her eyes. With the hope of finally being able to live the ordinary life and enjoy the normal everyday moments she has always longed for, Jihye makes a deal with the dokkaebi. But there are beings watching the two of them from afar and from close by. What is the story tying together the dokkaebi and the Mountain Spirit, and was the meeting between Jihye and the dokkaebi really just a coincidence?

description:
Infant formula lids, yogurt spoons... Hunsung Tech, a small-to-medium enterprise specializing in small plastic products. Peek inside, and you'll find a family (?) business where the CEO, his son, brother-in-law, younger brother, and daughter-in-law each hold a position, squeezing the life out of other employees.

Within this Hunsung Tech, Manager Lee Gyeong-Min, working in administration, is the company's ace. His sharp work ethic, early morning arrivals, and late nights are standard. He covers for the incompetence of upper management and even looks out for the treatment of production workers. After years of struggling like this, his patience reached its limit. Then, something astonishing happened in Lee Gyeong-Min's life. 

Escape from the black company, job change, success, and even marriage. 99% of South Korea is made up of small and medium-sized enterprises! The fierce success story of one young man unfolding within one such SME.

(Source: Naver, translated)

description:
Theodora Norton, my mother, lived her entire life in emotional suffering because of her husband. 

“I’ve prepared everything so you won’t have to live like me.” 

With her last breath, Theodora revealed that she had prepared not one, but several perfect men for my twenty-fourth birthday. I dismissed it as nothing more than the lingering resentment of a woman hurt by her husband’s infidelity until my father brought home a new wife, Agatha, and her daughter, Eplin, right after the funeral. Six years later, on my birthday, my father died. 

Just as I face losing my entire inheritance to Agatha and Eplin, five of the most powerful and sought-after men in the empire appear before me just as my mother had promised. 

Alfred, the eldest son of the southern admiral’s family. 

Percival, the Grand Duke of the North and a war hero. 

Kasius, a man with a suspiciously thriving business. 

Magnus, my former rival and now a renowned art patron. 

And Carter, my childhood friend, who knows everything about me and is now the High Priest.

description:
Oh Ga-eun goes to a job interview, hoping to finally escape unemployment. But… she sat in the wrong seat. 

“Ms. Yoon Hye-jin, right?” 

“I’m Oh Ga-eun…?” 

It wasn’t a company interview. It was an interview to become someone’s bride. The man in front of her is Joo Seok-jin, the president of Jushin Retail— a man who’s currently “recruiting” a wife. 

“Today’s interview to find my wife is a secret.” 

She promises to keep it confidential and leaves— only to run into him again at a vacation spot she spent all her savings to visit. Then a headline suddenly breaks: 

[Chairman Joo Seok-jin to Marry This September] 

“What do you think about becoming my bride, Ms. Oh Ga-eun?” 

“Fine. But don’t you dare cut my salary or allowances.” 

And just like that, their contract marriage begins. 

Position: Fake wife 
Job: Daughter-in-law of a chaebol family 
Additional duty: Surviving the in-laws.

 She was only supposed to act like the troublesome third daughter-in-law— so why does the way that man looks at her feel so sincere? A contract marriage that started with a mistaken interview seat. It began as something fake… but can their feelings stay fake too?

description:
In order to fulfill a certain contract, Sobom has been pretending to be a cleaning robot. Cold sweat trickles down her back.   
  
“Robot.”     

His indifferent voice, and once again his hand touches something dangerous beneath the shower gown.      

“But instead of washing rags… can’t you do something else?”     

Her startled gaze lifts straight to Dogyeol’s eyes. Gulp. Without realizing it, Sobom swallows hard, her throat tight with tension.     

“Oh my. Your face is really hot. Is it a battery issue?”     

He kneels down on one knee. Just as she lowers her eyes in unease, she meets Dogyeol’s gaze—he’s looking up at her with a playful smile.     

“I’d better check.”      

His smiling hand slowly lifts the hem of her maid outfit. Sobom flinches at the unexpected sensation, biting down hard on her lip.     

“Feels just like a human thigh…Was the battery slot here?”

title: Dissolve: His Last Choice
description:
< Dissolve: A film editing technique where one scene gradually overlaps another on the same screen as transition occurs. >

Song Hyunsoo, an unknown actor who makes a living as a bartender.
He gets cast in a famous director’s film and ends up acting alongside the nation’s famous actor, Yoon Juho.

He drinks only water that costs 400,000 won.
He replaces managers as casually as eating a meal.
—Yoon Juho, a man surrounded by countless rumors.

“Where do you live?”
“It’s okay. I can take the bus.”
“I asked where you live. I didn’t say I’d take you home.”
“…Bogwang-dong.”
“I will take you there.”

Though his words are mean, Hyunsoo becomes curious about the unexpectedly gentle side hidden in his past,
and a strange tension begins to form between the two.

“I fail to live up to expectations, leave people alone, hurt them… and every moment I’m reminded that I’m a defective product who only looks fine on the outside. When it comes to relationships, those are the only memories I have.”

But it doesn’t seem easy to conquer a prince who has lived his entire life as a top star…

The past he never even properly began to face fades away, and a new love approaches.
Change and growth to create a final love—and the final choice.

title: Gaemigul
description:
The filthy, vulgar den of crime: the Ant Hill. I was born and raised here—a pure-blood ant. 
Though in the end, I'm nothing more than an ordinary worker ant. 

Ants aren't allowed to escape. And maybe it was the price for dreaming of freedom... Instead of an ID, the only thing that came back was my friend, reduced to ashes in the incinerator. 

Just when I had resigned myself to everything, Jang Heejo, the true master of the Ant Hill, appeared before me. 

"So... do you want to make me yours?"

"My first time will be with the person I love."

Love? First time? Way too romantic to come from the mouth of a man who causes bloodshed every single day. 

"Even if it isn't love, I'm fine with that."

"We'll see..."

The tables turned in an instant.

description:
I went on a blind date as a stand-in for my older sister… only to find out the man was my supervising professor at the university hospital. Jeong Dasom agreed to take her sister’s place on a blind date for a small allowance of 300,000 won. But her date turned out to be a professor in the Emergency Medicine Department at SJ University Hospital—the very place where she was about to start her residency! He was infamous in the ER for being cold and ruthless, and if he found out she was just a substitute, her hospital life would be over before it even began. “Since we’re both at a perfectly suitable age for marriage, I’d like us to seriously consider seeing each other. What do you think?” …Wait. Was that basically a proposal just now? No, that’s not the problem. Should I confess right now—“I’m not your actual blind date, I’m just a stand-in!”? Or should I just quietly run away? Just as her mind went into full panic mode, an emergency call came in, and the man rushed back to the hospital. Not long after, the two met again—this time as professor and resident. Will Dasom be able to keep the truth about the substitute blind date hidden until the end? A clumsy, soft-hearted resident, Jeong Dasom, tangled up in a fake blind date, and a so-called cold-blooded emergency medicine professor, Tae Kang-hyuk—who, for some reason, is gentle only with her. A heart-racing medical romance set in the emergency room!

unknown.title: The End of Unrequited Love (PARK Seung-Ah)

description:
For 8 long years, I clung to a one-sided love, until I finally put an end to it.

He never once looked my way. Instead, I became the subject of whispered mockery and careless cruelty, wounds I carried in silence. Even so, I convinced myself that someday he would turn around and see me. Only now did I realize the truth. It wasn’t love. It was obsession.

So I made a decision. I would forget the Crown Prince. I would stop wounding myself over someone who never chose me and start seeking a happiness that belonged solely to me.

"This is the end. From now on, I’ll live for myself."

That was what I believed, until he appeared again, no longer the Crown Prince but the Emperor.

"What is my fiancée doing here?"

As though nothing had changed, he addressed me so naturally. The past I thought I had closed the door on stood before me once again, and the emotions I had carefully buried began to stir.

Why now? What does he want?

A woman determined to end her love, and a man who refuses to believe it ever ended.

Staring at the scars left behind by 8 years of unrequited devotion, I ask myself,

This time... can I truly let it go?

Just as he’s getting fully aroused while enjoying the video alone in his car, a stranger suddenly approaches him. The man, hunched over, asks to borrow a light. This man, so beautiful and elegant that Dong-Sik has never even seen his like on TV, takes Dong-Sik’s lighter and walks away. As Dong-Sik watches him go, he witnesses the man, who had been standing uneasily at the end of the breakwater, suddenly jump into the sea. Without a moment’s hesitation, Dong-Sik jumps into the sea after him. But in the pitch-black darkness, the man is nowhere to be found. Just as Dong-Sik is about to surface in the pitch-black sea where he can see nothing, something begins to pull at his ankle...

During his time in an orphanage, after being abandoned by his parents and unable to endure the abuse, he had run away on his own. When he finally managed to reunite with his father, the joy of their reunion was short-lived; his father took all the money Dong-Sik had saved and disappeared again. Dong-Sik then ended up working under a loan shark, taking on all sorts of dangerous jobs and narrowly escaping death on numerous occasions. Dong-Sik’s last memory was a plea: “Please let me be born into a wealthy family in my next life, so I can live without a single worry.” When he opened his eyes again, he found himself in a top-tier private hospital room—neither heaven nor hell. And in the mirror stood not Park Dong-Sik, but the man Dong-Sik had been trying to save. As Dong-Sik stood bewildered by this utterly incomprehensible phenomenon, another man appeared, volunteering to be his guardian. The man, who suddenly kissed him while asking, “How could you forget me?” was calling Dong-Sik “sister-in-law.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

description:
A carriage more luxurious than I’ve ever seen, a mansion so big I couldn’t tell if it was a home or a castle. My seven-year-old life, spent cozily with my father in a rural village, changed forever when the immensely wealthy Count Travel finally tracked down his runaway second son.

My dad is a noble? I have a rich grandfather?!

My relatives didn’t give my father a warm welcome after his six-years absence; instead, they pierced him with cold, hostile glares. n that moment, strange scenes began to surface my mind like a torrential rainstorm.

Berry, you must be careful of the relatives. Travel is a den of beasts, all hunting for the position of family head.

Lady Berry! News has arrived… Young Master Reitan has been killed in action!

Seven years old, ten years old, sixteen years old…
They were all me, yet they were memories I didn’t remember.
And in every single one of those memories, my father met a meaningless, tragic death.

***

This… this can’t possibly be real.

“Head Butler, did you recently purchase a large amount of stock in an ink company that’s about to go bankrupt?”
“That company would never go bust… Wait, how did you know I bought those stocks?”

Ack! That was exactly right, too!

If these memories are real, then this time, I will save my father no matter what.

But I can’t do this alone.
I need an ally who will be my greatest pillar of support.
Fortunately, there is a hidden gem that only I know of.
Someone who looks like a mud-covered pebble right now, so no one thinks to keep their guard up.

“Crown Prince Theon Phil Boltman.”

My first plan is to make that young boy my ally.

description:
Unpredictable! What will be the ending of this heart-pounding feeling?

When she gets a “hunch,” she’s right 100% of the time!

Boyoung, known as the “master of hunches,” is a couple manager who ranks first in matching success thanks to her almost supernatural sixth sense.

But, as the saying goes, “a monk can’t shave his own head.” Her own love life fails again and again. On top of that, because those hunches come to her anytime and anywhere, people often treat her like a strange person. That is why her first meeting with Eungi was, in short, a complete disaster.

A handsome face, but a personality that doesn’t match.

Eungi, famous as a divorce lawyer, does not believe in love, which he considers nothing more than an empty emotion, after witnessing the unhappy end of his parents’ marriage during his childhood.

Then, while handling a divorce case, Eungi is attacked by a stranger and loses his memory. When he sees Boyoung, who comes to visit him at the hospital, his heart begins to race like crazy.

When his memories suddenly return upon seeing her, Eungi starts looking for her every day, using his memory as an excuse. However, at the same time, he hurls cruel words at her, saying that “once he regains his memory, this heart-pounding feeling will disappear too”...

What will be the ending of this romance that began by chance?

Now, he is trapped in a collision between the woman from his daily life and the one from the digital shadows. It wasn’t truly love he was seeking, but a sense of salvation. This is the chronicle of a “trash-tier” romance, ignited by the desperate fantasies of a man with nothing left to lose.

description:
“The way you look at me… it hasn’t changed. Just like ten years ago.” 

Ten years ago— a burning summer. That’s when she first met Tae-hyuk. And eight years ago— a winter so cold it hurt. That’s when she abandoned him. 

“Even if you stabbed me in the back… even if you erased my child… I’m saying I still won’t let you go. That bastard came all this way just to ask about you.”

“I’m not leaving. Not for you. Even if it kills me, I’m not going.” ⁎

[Sex Practice? I’ll Help You.]

“Let’s stop. Us.”

Those were the words my lover said to me as I lay there catching my breath after sex. Even if a sudden downpour had fallen from a clear sky, I think I would have been less shaken than I was in that moment.

“Why? What brought this on all of a sudden?”  
“Sex with you isn’t fun.”

This is already the third time I’ve been dumped for such an absurd, bewildering reason. I’ve gone past emptiness and sadness and started wondering if there really is something wrong with me.

“Hey, Seohyun. What does it… actually mean… to be good at it?”  
“Excuse me? Good at what?”  
“…Sex. I was thinking of trying to practice on my own, at least.”

It was something I blurted out while drunk, half out of spite. I felt wronged, but I was also genuinely curious. Just how amazing is the sex everyone else is having?

“I can help you.”  
“Huh?”

But something feels off. As Seohyun quietly listens to my worries, his eyes seem filled with heat. Is that just because I’ve had too much to drink?

“I said I’ll help you. With that practice.”

title: How to Break a Jinx
description:
Ace pitcher Kang Jihwan and star batter Baek Hwigyeom built their friendship around a single ball since childhood.
After graduating high school, they both successfully went pro through the rookie draft, and their youth seemed to be on a smooth, unstoppable path… At least until their seventh year, when Hwigyeom fell into a hellish slump he never could have imagined.

Dating? No. Drinking or smoking? Absolutely not. Going out? Only a strict home–stadium routine. Even self-pleasure? Completely cut off, all in on training. And yet his performance kept plummeting, his pride hitting rock bottom. A man ruled by superstitions, sensitive even to the smallest pre-game routine, Hwigyeom was driven mad by a slump that only deepened without any clear reason.

Frustrated, he calls up Jihwan - now on a different team - and they go out for drinks. Drinking recklessly like nothing matters, Hwigyeom ends up completely wasted… When he comes to his senses, he finds himself lying in bed with his best friend, Jihwan. And they’ve already… done *that*.

The next day, too embarrassed to even make eye contact, Hwigyeom heads to the stadium and is given a rare pinch-hitting opportunity. And in that moment - a walk-off three-run home run. A dramatic comeback that makes his seven-year slump seem meaningless.

Leaving him with just one conclusion:  
…Did what happened last night become his new superstition?

title: Nongbu Lee Sam-Tak
description:
Lee Sam-Tak, 28 and single, quit his job and moved back to his hometown to become a farmer, where he bought some farmland. He then had business cards printed with “Farmer” as his occupation and handed them out to everyone he met. He was worried that the neighbors, curious about his move to the countryside, might bombard him with annoying questions or gossip.

Lee Sam-Tak handed out those business cards. And once he did, the word “farmer” printed on those cards became the name the locals used to address him. That’s right—it became his proper name. Even if Lee Sam-Tak is clumsy at farming and ruins the crops, people still call him “Farmer”—as if mocking him. Even when Lee Sam-Tak runs around the mountains day in and day out with a shotgun, claiming he’s hunting animals that harm the crops, people still call him “Farmer.” 

No, no. What if—just what if—for real! Let’s say Lee Sam-Tak says he’s “just taking a break.” Even then, they’d still call him “Farmer.” Those villagers would. Because that’s what Lee Sam-Tak wants.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: Rawongi
description:
In a world where gods and humans coexist, there is a land called Rawon (羅園). The gods here survive by feeding on the reverence of humans, and in return use that power to protect them. Humans, meanwhile, live their lives under the gods’ grace, bound together in a “cycle of reverence and blessing.”

Yusa, the river god of Cheongyugang, has refused human reverence for nearly a century after losing his beloved human disciple, Tan’eo. Whenever he comes close to losing his divinity and fading into a lesser creature, he barely prolongs his fragile existence by borrowing divine power through “hapshin,” a union with the mountain god Gaho, who secretly harbors feelings for him.

Meanwhile, Dajin, the son of a great general whose entire clan was slaughtered by an evil god, longs to become an “Inje” — a human emperor chosen by the gods — for the sole purpose of revenge. Confident in his exceptional martial skill, he asks to become Gaho’s disciple, but Gaho sees through the vengeance consuming his heart and rejects him. Driven into despair by the belief that the gods abandoned both his parents and himself, Dajin ultimately throws himself into the Cheongyu River.

Wishing that no more humans connected to him would die, Yusa saves Dajin by passing on the last of his remaining divinity through a kiss, exhausting his own strength in the process. When Dajin awakens, he dismisses Yusa’s actions as mere whimsy and lashes out in anger. Demanding that Yusa take the divine power back, he impulsively kisses him in return.

In that fleeting moment of contact, the two share each other’s wounds and true feelings, unintentionally forming a master-disciple contract. Through “hapshin,” the act of exchanging divine power, Yusa gains the vitality needed to survive, while Dajin obtains the strength he needs for revenge.

A god unable to escape the scars of the past, and a human willing to risk his life for vengeance. As Rawon’s greatest competition, the Jeseonje (帝選祭), approaches for the first time in a hundred years, their desperate yet sensual tale of salvation begins.

---

description:
*“I've been seeing ghosts since I was a kid. And only male ghosts, at that.”*

Young Jae-Yeong has a secret. Eventually, he succeeds in making the ghosts disappear, but due to repeated school transfers and spiritual rituals, Jae-Yeong becomes physically and emotionally exhausted, feeling empty inside. When Jae-Yeong returns to his neighborhood, he is greeted by Do-Ha. Do-Ha, who used to be a timid younger brother who cried at the drop of a hat, had grown tall enough to look down on Jae-Yeong. But the joy is short-lived, as Do-Ha begins to gradually disrupt Jae-Yeong’s daily life.

Victor tells Fine, “I’ll grant you your revenge, but in exchange, give me everything you have.” 

What he asks of her is to infiltrate the “Room of Domination,” the secret space of the crown prince and princess, and retrieve the vow ring containing the contract between the royal family and Victor. Fine and Victor begin working together toward the same goal. Though they constantly clash at first, before long, they begin to soothe each other’s loneliness and find themselves drawn to one another…

title: Broken Engagement Scandal
description:
“Let’s call off the engagement.” 

Chihun lets out a hollow laugh, his eyes wandering aimlessly in the air. His dark gaze fixed on Seoyeon, heightening the tension around them. Just like her newly cropped hair, Seoyeon left Chihun without a shred of regret. However, after three years without contact, Chihun suddenly reappears before her. 

“You’re different from the Jin Seoyeon I knew.” 

“But why do I feel like this is your true self?” 

“Why do I feel like you’ve been deceiving me?” 

As he speaks, his eyes seem to glisten with unshed tears. Looking haggard as if he hasn’t slept for days, Seoyeon finds herself unable to look away from him. 

“Sleep with me, Jin Seoyeon.” 

And so, once again, Seoyeon finds herself unable to refuse his proposal.

From that day on, their relationship deepens and eventually turns romantic. But their peace is short-lived. description:
"Look only at me, where I can see you."      

"How would you like to attend a dinner as my partner, Ms. Yun Ha-ru?"

"Honestly, I'm uncomfortable and find it difficult to be involved with you, Mr. Cho Jae-yun."    

"What should I do? I have no intention of letting you go."    

Ha-ru thought everything would end once she accepted his proposal and got her notebook back. But hearing his words, which sounded like he needed her, and feeling a warmth and consideration she had never received before, her fragile heart kept drifting toward him. Even though she knew she was nothing more or less than a partner to this man, it was like a swamp she could neither reject nor escape.    

"I like you."

title: The Moment the Gap Opened
description:
"How big a size can you handle?" 

A question, excessively lewd and rude, echoed through the quiet exhibition hall. Lee Jun’s gaze, which seemed to scan her work but eventually settled on Jihyun’s body, resembled that of a beast. The man, who vanished after leaving behind a sense of shame and a strange excitement, knocks on the door of Jihyun’s studio the next day. Jihyun’s hands touch the muddy clay on the spinning potter's wheel. The moment the sound of the wheel is drowned out by heavy breathing, Jihyun realizes that the question from that day wasn't about the size of the clay to be placed on the wheel. 

Lee Jun's temptation is more destructive than her ex-husband's obsession and relentless pursuit. Jihyun finds herself willing to sink into that dangerous gap that has opened in her life.

*“I wanted you, and it’s not like I actually dislike you, but I can’t stand being treated this way.”*

Min Jeong-Ha was adopted as the youngest son of a shamanic family that has been sought out by political and business tycoons for generations. Having grown up as the sole recipient of the attention and affection of his older brother, Min Ji-Han, who is three years his senior and possesses both a steady, gentle disposition and business acumen. Jeong-Ha suddenly becomes a thorn in the family’s side the moment he enters college. Behind Jeong-Ha’s sudden change lies the truth he has just discovered: he was adopted to serve as a scapegoat for the Min family… Filled with rage at the betrayal of being used by the very people he believed were his family, Jeong-Ha pushes Ji-Han away. Faced with Jeong-Ha’s sudden change in attitude, Ji-Han tries to force him to comply and attempts to get rid of the “problem” to win him back… But in trying to escape his brother’s disastrous obsession, has he instead brought upon himself an even worse disaster?!

description:
Coldly neglected by her husband, Hyperion, who loved another woman, and surrounded by conspiracies and betrayals from both inside and outside her home, Kaela gradually lost her will to live.

Then one day, in the dead center of a swirling war, Kaela meets her end through starvation and poison. To her, death felt as sweet as a blessing.

Blink. When she opened her eyes, she had returned to the time before her marriage. Was it a dream? Or… a curse? The terrifying realization that she had to live through it all again slowly squeezed her heart.

However, this wasn’t her regression alone.

Hyperion had also returned. And his reason for regressing was singularly focused.

This time, he would make sure she didn’t die. No, to be perfectly exact… he would make it so that she couldn’t die.

I Stole the Trashy Crown Prince's First Night

คืนแรกของเจ้าชาย...ทำไมกลายเป็นฉัน?!
皇太子の初夜を奪ってしまった

description:
I, Robellyn Dines, was reincarnated into the world of a satisfying revenge novel.

The problem was that I’d become the villainess doomed to be destroyed by that very revenge.

After having an affair with the Crown Prince, who was supposed to be the female lead’s husband, and committing countless evil deeds, her fate in the original story was to die beneath the guillotine.

But there’s no way I’m going to live like that.

“Fine. I’ll get rid of that useless excuse for a husband before anything even starts!”

All I had to do was push the original female lead and male lead together and escape this cursed storyline for good.

And I succeeded.

I even managed to prevent the moment that originally caused the female lead and Crown Prince Ian to fall in love.

But…

‘Why the hell is this man sleeping next to me?’

By accident, I ended up spending the night with the Crown Prince himself.

At this rate, things are no different from the original story! 

Panicking, I fled the scene immediately. After all, Ian was infamous for being a playboy. I’m sure he’ll forget a one-night mistake soon enough.

—

“You’re the one. The woman who slept with me and ran away.”

The moment I noticed Ian’s hand blocking the door, I realized something had gone terribly wrong.

“N- no, I think you’ve mistaken me for someone else—”

“Really?”

At my desperate denial, Ian only curled his lips into a dangerous smile. With slow, unhurried movements, he began undoing the buttons of his shirt one by one.

“Then shall we confirm it?”

“C- confirm what exactly?”

“Whether or not you’re the woman from that night. If we reenact it, you’ll remember soon enough.”

With those words, the final button of his shirt came undone.

title: The Rogue Boss
description:
Cha Seung-jo is the young leader who propelled Muyoung Hotel to the number one spot in the industry. He is a man for whom the path he walks becomes the road, and his will becomes the law. He has never been a subordinate since the day he was born, but there was once a single person who brought him absolute humiliation...

"Your hands are slow. Shoveling. Can't you do it properly?"

During his active military service, his platoon leader made him shovel like crazy: Seo Eun-jae.

'Platoon Leader, if you ever see me in the real world, your jaw will drop. You'll think, "How did I dare order someone like that around?"'

She was so stubborn and upright that his petty cheekiness never worked on her at all. Who would have thought that very platoon leader would suddenly appear right before his eyes—and as his secretary, no less!

"I will do my best with my assigned duties. This time, as your secretary."

From that day on, things he never expected in his life began to happen.

"Want to sleep with me?"    
"Ah, you don't even want a meal? Do you hate everything that starts with the letter 'S'?"

And the most shocking, bolt-from-the-blue event of all...

"Then let's just kiss."

...He ended up doing some crazy "shoveling" after all.

Assuming he’d apologize, Chae-Rin looks up only to find a surprisingly tall and handsome man standing there. But instead of apologizing, he coldly brushes her hand aside and walks away without a word. Despite this disastrous first encounter, Chae-Rin finds herself strangely intrigued by him. After asking around, she discovers that he is a classmate named Jang Ryu-Hyeon…

Chae-Rin hatches a plan to thoroughly seduce him, make him fall for her, and then dump him without mercy. With this romance beginning with such an unexpected twist, will he really remain Chae-Rin’s plaything until the very end?

title: Love:Zero
description:
Jiyu, a student at Astor School—an elite private all-girls academy in Manhattan’s Upper East Side—lives in the same apartment building as Hunter, who attends Alton School, the all-boys academy just across the street. However, between Hunter, who lives in the penthouse of a luxury Fifth Avenue apartment overlooking Central Park, and Jiyu, who lives in a first-floor affordable housing unit, there exists a gap. Even their personalities are polar opposites: Jiyu loves to sit quietly and read books, while Hunter cannot stay still for even a single second.

Showing a natural talent for tennis, Hunter begins competing in earnest in tournaments and wins every single match Jiyu attends. Because of this, Hunter becomes convinced that Jiyu is his winning good luck charm. Eventually, the turbulent storm of adolescence finds them both. Amidst all this, tragedy strikes Jiyu. With nowhere else to go, the Hamilton family takes her in, but Jiyu is relegated from being Hunter's friend to nothing more than a servant. Jiyu exploits Hunter to survive, while Hunter exploits Jiyu because of his superstition.

In a tennis match, "Love" means zero. A love game is a game where one player's score is zero. Bound together in a tangled web of love and hate, the two face each other across the net, trading volleys in a love game. Who will ultimately emerge as the winner of this game?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Burdened with a debt of 180 million won due to his father’s business failure and his mother’s major surgery, Chang-Hyeon had been drifting from one job to another in the entertainment industry. Desperate to raise money, he turned to his high school classmate U A-Jun, a former rival and the illegitimate son of a chaebol family, as a last resort. 

*“Crawl over here. Onto the table.”*

At the moment of their reunion, A-Jun reveals his twisted true colors and demands that Chang-Hyeon become nothing more than a toy to warm his bed in exchange for the money. Suddenly reduced to a kept man, Chang-Hyeon finds himself trapped in a villa on “Nakdo,” a remote island in the middle of the ocean….

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

description:
I was reincarnated as a supporting villain character. A trashy princess who was obsessed with the big brother of the cute heroine and eventually poisoned the heroine to destroy her. I made up my mind and prepared to run away. After saving the heroine, things went wrong.

"Those who touch her, chase them to the end of the world and destroy them."  
"Imperial family? The incompetent imperial family that makes Titania unhappy. They don’t matter anyway."  
"Hahahaha, they call me a mad dog. If a mad dog bites people, is it crazy?"

Gee, calm down everyone.  
Because I’m leaving to enjoy my dreams, hopes, and money in a seaside villa with beautiful waves! Everyone should be happy too! I thought so…

"…I thought you were really dead. I…"  
His golden eyes that contained me were engulfed in emotions I couldn’t read. I felt like I was going to drown just by looking at it.  
"…It felt like an endless nightmare, Tia."  
"Please don’t disappear in front of me like that anymore," while whispering earnestly.  
I was at a loss for words to say to him, who grabbed my hand as if tying me to go nowhere.

And…  
"It’s okay to hate my brother! But, don’t hate the duke’s money!"  
…The cute heroine who gives me the key to the underground safe containing all the treasures…  
"Is everything bothering you? Then choose me instead. Don’t let it bother yourself, Duchess. I’ll be by your side anytime, anywhere."  
Even the second older brother of the female protagonist, who always looked at me like a thorn in his eyes, became a bit strange. What is wrong here?

description:
Seo-hwa’s fiancé, Won-ui—whom she believed died five years ago—returns alive as a war hero. But instead of love, he comes back filled with hatred, declaring that he survived only to kill her.

Years earlier, Seo-hwa’s father, the paranoid emperor of Songyang, allowed political schemes to destroy Won-ui’s family under false accusations of treason. Unable to save him, Seo-hwa watched helplessly as his family was executed and believed Won-ui himself had died.

After the emperor’s death, Seo-hwa’s jealous brother forces her into a miserable marriage, dragging her life into ruin. Five years later, a rebellion topples the tyrant, and Won-ui returns victorious. Though he hates Seo-hwa as the daughter of the man who destroyed his family, he still cannot bring himself to kill her.

Instead, he asks the new emperor to hand Seo-hwa over as a servant to his household. 

Now, the two former lovers—both broken by tragedy, revenge, guilt, and lingering love—are trapped in a painful relationship neither can escape.

Yeon-woo and her family of three live in an old, low-rise apartment building on the outskirts of Seoul.
Her mother is always busy with work at a restaurant, and her older brother, a high school senior, is on edge preparing for the college entrance exam.
To make matters worse, even her one and only best friend moves away, leaving Yeon-woo feeling like a loner.

Then one day, she meets a friend in her dreams who looks exactly like her—a girl named Maeum (Heart).
From that moment, Yeon-woo's life begins to change little by little.

description:

To Ki-Jeong, the owner was the only person in his entire life who believed in him just as he was.

*“Ki-Jeong, your hands and feet are bigger than mine. That means you could end up taller than me, too.”*

But the happiness was short-lived; without a word, the owner resigned from his scouting position and vanished completely. Five years later the owner returns to his former team with a new title as a performance analysis manager, where he is reunited with Ki-Jeong, now a professional baseball player who has grown beyond recognition. Though taken aback by Ki-Jeong’s changed appearance, the owner finds himself unable to look away...

However, to show her father, who had been diagnosed with a terminal illness, that she was getting married, Rin-Ah decided to end her relationship with Jun-Kyung and go on arranged dates. Yet, even that did not go as planned. Every time Rin-Ah went on a date, Tae Jun-Kyung invariably sabotaged it. The one remark he spat out after belatedly awakening to his emotions: 

“Then marry me. Marriage is nothing. If you’ve turned a perfectly normal guy into a fool, you have to take responsibility.” 

It was the late awakening of a man who had never known love—he was worthy of being called a madman.

"Deal! But are you going to eat that bread in your pocket? Give it to me."

title: Neo Gateun Geon
description:
Jeong Yi-an, who has spent his 34 years dating only women, harbours a desire to sleep with a man just once. Then, at a high school reunion he attended by chance, he meets Kim Su-hyuk.

With his tousled hair, black horn-rimmed glasses, checked shirt, large frame and taciturn demeanour—seeing that he was exactly the same as ever, he felt a sense of warmth, whilst also thinking that if Kim Su-hyeok were to be his one-night stand, it might actually be quite alright.

*“Can we meet again sometime?”  
“Is that really necessary?”  
“Is it because I wasn’t good enough?”  
“Not exactly. Just one night. It wasn’t bad, was it?”*

However, sleeping with him wasn’t as thrilling as Yi-an had imagined. Just as he was about to dismiss it as a one-night fling, Su-hyeok unexpectedly got in touch first.

*“I can promise you it’ll be different this time. …I’ve been practising a lot.”  
“I’m just asking, just in case. You don’t actually like me or anything, do you?”  
“No.”  
“Right. See you again.”*

Clearly, at first, it had been nothing more than a new thrill in his monotonous daily life. Yet, as his meetings with Su-hyeok continued, laughter, joy and a tingling sense of excitement began to accompany them, and the bond between them—which had spanned sixteen years—began to take on a slightly different form…

title: Mr. Rabbit Descends
description:
“Stay on land and live with me forever.” 

To cure the Dragon King’s illness, the liver of a Rabbit divine beast is required. Byeol-hee, a soft-shelled turtle spirit tasked with luring the beast and obtaining its liver, arrives on land and meets the beautiful rabbit, Myo-woon. 

“...A fairy? Am I finally dead?”    
“I’m not a fairy, and I’m not a woman either.” 

Thinking Myo-woon is an orphan spirit who grew up alone, Byeol-hee asks him to help with her mission, believing he knows the land well. Meanwhile, Myo-woon, desperate to keep the first person he’s truly talked to in a long time by his side, hides his identity as a divine beast and accompanies her... 

‘That poor thing, he must have suffered so much.’    
‘He’s a bit dim, but he’s such a cute little kid.’ 

A Rabbit and a Turtle with completely different agendas. A brand-new version of the classic folktale, 'The Rabbit and the Turtle'!

The trouble began when Seon-U, who appeared on the music variety show “Eco Star,” covered a Prism Noise song and the cover version ended up becoming more famous than the original. Compounding the problem, the drummer and guitarist both announced their departures one after another, ultimately bringing Prism Noise’s activities to an end. A troubled Do-Hyeon happens to find a drunk Seon-U and takes him back to his hotel…

This incident leads the two to start keeping in touch, and they become confidants who listen to each other’s worries. Upon learning of this, Jae-Hun begins to show signs of insecurity toward Do-Hyeon and Seon-U, and the conflict between Do-Hyeon and Jae-Hun, who were once a couple, escalates out of control. title: Geomeun Geurimjareul Bapgo Seoseo
description:
"You are my only lover and my complete woman. I adore you." 

Yu, the Galmun-wang, was once the son of a Crown Prince, but after losing his parents to the current Emperor, he has lived only waiting for the day of his revenge. One day, he heads to a gisaeng house to stop the Emperor from destroying the few people he has left, and there he happens to save Tae-ju, who was about to be sold as a gisaeng. He kept her by his side because she had nowhere to go, but she was a pure and untainted woman. Far too good for a man like him, whose life is filled with the stench of blood. Trying to ignore his deepening feelings, he forced her away, only to regret it immediately. He shouldn't have let her go. However, he encountered her in the Imperial Palace—the place where he thought he would never see her again. Why she was in the Imperial Palace did not matter. The lips pressed against her smooth cheeks were hot and utterly ecstatic. 

"I knew I couldn't stay by your side forever, my benefactor. That is not my place."     
"You cannot leave me now. That is not allowed." 

How could he let go of this small, lovely butterfly that had flown to him for the first time? 

"You are mine."

title: Hwan-Sang-ui Love Line
description:
_“I like this actor, you know.”_

Yoonsang is cast in *After Mass*, a new drama from Nflix Korea. His character’s love interest is Jeong Dohwan, a brilliant actor from the independent film scene whom Yoonsang has secretly admired.

But when they finally meet, Dohwan turns out to be a man Yoonsang simply cannot get a read on...?!
Playful yet serious, kind yet rude, Dohwan is a free spirit who completely throws Yoonsang off balance, despite Yoonsang’s nickname of “Prince Alpha” and his tendency to fall in love at the drop of a hat.

Dohwan seems interested, yet never quite crosses the line.
Even after acting as bitter rivals with him, Yoonsang finds himself asking him out on dates once the cameras stop rolling.
He plays Dohwan’s Omega, but in reality, pheromones have no effect on him.
Love built on stubbornness and pride!
Will he be able to win the heart of this seemingly unapproachable acting genius?

He may have a reputation as a Hollywood Casanova, but I’m definitely going to make him the one who can’t keep his composure!

_Source: Ridibooks, translated_

description:
"Hire me. Business will boom if you hire someone with a face like mine."     

A suspicious new employee arrives at a shabby pub. He lives in a tiny studio apartment, yet he carries himself like a prince who owns the world. Why is he so confident despite constantly making trivial mistakes? Ji-woo, the pub manager, can't help but be bothered by him.      

"Noona, did you see that guy's car? It's a supercar worth over a billion won."      

As expected, he's strange and suspicious. Ji-woo doesn't want to admit she's attracted to him, but he keeps provoking her with his playful tone. 

"I told you, everything I have is on the larger side."     
"How could you possibly understand a body that even I don't fully understand?"    

Then, one day, he kisses her with a gaze of unfathomable depth. 

"Date me for a month. Properly." 

A strange secret romance begins with a suspicious man. Will she be able to end it safely after a month?

title: Without Anyone Knowing
description:
Chae Yeonah attends a blind date in place of her younger sister, Chae Sia, who is undergoing treatment for a serious illness. The man she is meant to meet is Seo Jeongju, heir to the Seonghwa Group and the object of Sia’s longtime platonic love.

Jeongju quickly falls for Yeonah and rushes toward marriage. Still pretending to be her sister, Yeonah goes so far as to marry him. However, when Sia recovers and moves into Jeongju’s home, he begins to sense that something is strangely amiss in his newlywed life.

Everything changes when their father, Chae Chungsu, mistakes Yeonah for Sia and accidentally reveals the truth. Yeonah discovers that she was deliberately abandoned at an orphanage and that her father and sister have only kept her close to use her as a potential kidney donor for Sia.

When Yeonah tries to make the truth public, Chungsu, who is preparing to run for president, decides to eliminate her. However, due to a mistake by the hitman, Sia is involved in the accident instead of Yeonah and falls into a coma.

Taking advantage of the situation, Yeonah assumes her sister Chae Sia’s identity and begins living her life while preparing to take revenge on the family that used and discarded her.

title: Binguijaga Danyeogan Hu
description:
[The tear-inducing adventure of Anais, who must clean up a multi-level marketing scam left behind after the possessor left.]

In a continent ruled by a black dragon, “possessors” who disrupt the peace begin to appear out of nowhere one day.

One tries to seduce the Crown Prince by claiming, “I am the childhood first love you lost,” while another goes all the way to see the Northern Duke entirely on her own, proposing, “I know the future, so let’s enter a contract marriage.”

Someone even shows up right in front of the black dragon, declaring, “I will execute the evil dragon!”

In the end, the dragon loses its patience and executes the possessors, and the continent seemingly regains its peace step by step…

But then, a whopping 33rd possessor appears in the Lesser Kingdom of Belfast.

Unlike the previous possessors, this one has absolutely no interest in the Crown Prince or the Northern Duke.

Instead, she only thinks about hitting the jackpot with a scam and escaping to the imperial capital, pitching, Once you reach the Diamond Grade, money will just roll right in!

…Until one day, like a divine punishment, a bolt of lightning strikes down upon the 33rd possessor.

And at that exact moment, the real Anais—who had fallen asleep looking forward to her 19th birthday—returns.

Anais got struck by lightning?

And on top of that, she pulled off a massive fraud?? Me? The princess of Belfast?

Anais, I think I’m going to faint…

But before Anais even gets a chance to pass out, Elliot, the Commander of the Azure Dragon Knights who hunts down possessors, barges in.

Come along quietly!

No! That’s not it! She’s not here! She’s gone! She left!

This is the modern, definitive take on Ben 10 from the team that created him – Man of Action – kicking off with writer Joe Casey, joined by amazing artist Robert Carey, with covers by Carey, Man of Action member Duncan Rouleau, Dustin Nguyen, Sebastian Piriz, and a special MYSTERY VARIANT BLIND BAG containing one limited edition of the issue selected randomly from a range of covers exclusive to this offering! title: Keeper of Scarlet Petals
description:

Less than a year into her training at Sanctuary, a college for Keepers and mages alike, all she wanted to do was continue mastering swordsmanship and avoid her other responsibilities. Those plans are ruined when she's assigned to be the protector of her biggest rival. He's cocky, smug, and drives her up a wall at every opportunity... and yet, Jasmine starts to find herself inexplicably drawn to him. Unfortunately, burgeoning romantic trouble is the least of Jasmine’s problems. As pieces of a malevolent plot start to unfold around them, she and her charge realize that there might be only one thing left that they can rely on. Each other.

_Source: Naver Webtoon_

description:
To escape hunger, Cheon Hwi took up the sword and eventually rose to the realm of a supreme master, earning the title of the Sword Ghost. Then came the Heavenly Demon, the greatest martial artist in history and a calamity feared throughout the Jianghu, plunging the Central Plains into ruin. Cheon Hwi met Tang Sowol, the Poison Empress of the Sichuan Tang Clan, who was left utterly alone after the Heavenly Demon slaughtered her entire clan. Bound by their shared desire for vengeance, the two fought side by side to kill the Heavenly Demon However, their blades never reached their target, and they met their deaths together on the same day, in the same place.

*"If only I had possessed a little more talent."

"If only I had had a little more time."

"If only I had mastered stronger martial arts."*

As his life ends in bitter regret, Cheon Hwi regresses 20 years into the past. Having swiftly regained the strength he once possessed, the now-young Cheon Hwi vows that this time, he will protect her no matter what. So he seeks out Tang Sowol, just as she is about to step into the martial world at nearly twenty years of age... ...and kidnaps her.

(Source: Naver, translated)

description:
In the early days of the Joseon Dynasty, there lived a famous warrior. Some described him as manly, uninhibited, and fiery, but most described him as "like a dog." The fact that he managed to survive amidst warriors who lived by the sword while maintaining such a wretched temperament can only be explained by one thing: he was strong—very strong, in fact.

Eventually, the king, after much deliberation, appointed him as the bodyguard for a diplomatic mission to the Ming Dynasty. Rumors circulated that the mission had been assembled unnecessarily just to send him away, but the king said nothing. In any case, that is how he left Joseon. This is the end of his story in Joseon... and the beginning of a new one.

description:
"Is touching men's bodies a hobby of yours, Hong Eun-jo?"  
In a hotel suite, Eun-jo was inadvertently fondling a man's body.    
And not just any man—her subordinate, her time-limited fake lover, and the man who was soon to become the ultimate boss of the company.   

"What are you talking about! I was just wiping off the wine."  
"While groping my chest as a bonus?"  
"G-Groping?" 

Looking up with a flabbergasted expression, Eun-jo heard Tae-hwi murmur lowly,
"You did it last time, too."   
"Th-That was because I spilled tomato juice..."  
"You used that as an excuse to touch me quite well, though." 

At his brazen remark, Eun-jo's jaw dropped.

"What are you doing? The wine is still flowing."

Eun-jo's gaze drifted downward from his chest.
The red wine spilled on his white shirt was soaking into his stomach and spreading down to his pants.   
Staring trance-like at the dripping wine, Eun-jo snapped back to reality and reminded herself of their contract condition:   
'Let's do everything except love.'  
And once again, she resolved herself:
To successfully bring this romance to an end.

title: Beol
description:
What if Yi Sun-Sin hadn’t died at the Battle of Noryang? 

Yi Sun-Sin is struck by enemy fire and falls during the Battle of Noryang, but after a series of twists and turns, he miraculously survives, and the seven-year Imjin War finally comes to an end. However, King Seon-Jo begins to feel pathological jealousy and extreme pressure toward Yi Sun-Sin, who has led the nation to victory in the war and emerged as a hero of the people. Eventually, King Seon-Jo colludes with key figures of the Seoin (Westerners) faction to secretly arrest Yi Sun-Sin, frame him as a traitor, and sentence him to capital punishment. The male members of Yi Sun-Sin’s family are either executed or exiled, while all the women are taken as government slaves and meet tragic fates. In the end, Yi Sun-Sin is secretly executed by being torn apart by horses (cheolyeol) within the abandoned palace, and even his remains are burned, leaving no trace. However, surprisingly, Yi Sun-Sin unexpectedly finds himself transported back to his youth, some 30 years earlier.

From that day forward, Yi Sun-Sin devises a grand plan to stop the Japanese invaders who ravaged Joseon and massacred its people, to exact retribution on his future ancestors who had exterminated him and his family, and to conquer Japan, the Jurchen, and China and he begins to methodically put this plan into action. Will Yi Sun-Sin succeed in his campaigns against the south and then the north?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: Baramui Madosa
description:
A Boy Who Lost Everything Becomes the Wizard of the Wind.

A world where spirits and magic coexist. Simon Hays is a boy born with a genius-level talent for magic, yet he grew up hiding his power due to his fate as the son of a family of warriors. One day, his father, Klein, attempts to kill Simon to satisfy his own greed, and Simon’s swordmaster, Rozette, and her daughter, Diana, fall to Klein’s blade. Having survived alone thanks to the sacrifice of his second older brother, Raidin, Simon abandons his former name and takes on the identity of “Ranian,” living as a mage and mercenary while tracking down Klein’s whereabouts. However, during his pursuit, he becomes entangled in incidents across the land, drawing closer to new truths connected to Klein, and survives by fighting alongside companions, each with their own stories. Ranian, who once lived solely for revenge, is forced to confront the meaning of life, power, and relationships anew through countless battles and choices.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: Baramui Madosa
description:
A Boy Who Lost Everything Becomes the Wizard of the Wind.

A world where spirits and magic coexist. Simon Hays is a boy born with a genius-level talent for magic, yet he grew up hiding his power due to his fate as the son of a family of warriors. One day, his father, Klein, attempts to kill Simon to satisfy his own greed, and Simon’s swordmaster, Rozette, and her daughter, Diana, fall to Klein’s blade. Having survived alone thanks to the sacrifice of his second older brother, Raidin, Simon abandons his former name and takes on the identity of “Ranian,” living as a mage and mercenary while tracking down Klein’s whereabouts. However, during his pursuit, he becomes entangled in incidents across the land, drawing closer to new truths connected to Klein, and survives by fighting alongside companions, each with their own stories. Ranian, who once lived solely for revenge, is forced to confront the meaning of life, power, and relationships anew through countless battles and choices.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

But, haunted by the past and his own quest for revenge, Rey is soon caught up in the destructive spectacle of the games, where the cost of power is blood, and the true prize is yet to be revealed.

A bold reenvisioning of the colonial history of Spain and the Philippines through an epic anti-imperialist fantasy about fighting for freedom in the face of empire.

_Source: Viz Media_

title: The Last Romeo
description:
The chairman of MS Group, Moon Junhyuk’s father, was murdered by his mistress. He was shot to death—and, to make matters worse, alongside Junhyuk’s stepmother. With scandalous rumors spreading everywhere and the family’s reputation already in ruins, Moon Junhyuk, the chairman’s only son, struggles desperately to protect the company while seething with anger. Then one day, he happens to meet Han Iseol and discovers that she is the younger sister of the woman who killed his father. After the humiliating deaths of his father and stepmother—the very people who had tormented him throughout his life—Junhyuk is looking for someone to take his anger out on, and he chooses Iseol as his target. His plan is simple: approach her as a kind and affectionate man, make her fall in love with him, become her boyfriend, and then cruelly abandon her just to make her suffer. But Iseol is also a victim, a woman carrying wounds every bit as deep as Junhyuk’s. As the two grow closer, what began as deception slowly turns into a sweet and genuine love. However, Iseol knows nothing about Junhyuk’s true identity or the revenge scheme that brought him into her life. When she finally discovers the truth, she is devastated.

description:
"Won't you marry me?" 

Haebom has lived confined behind high walls by the Songjeong Foods family. At the onset of spring, as winter was coming to an end, Haebom met Kang Ihan. 

"They say dimples are traces of God touching a face because it was too pretty."  
  
"He must have adored you very much."    

The man set to marry her sister. A man as unattainable as the moon, Kang Ihan. Yet, he keeps reaching out his hand to her. 

"Marry me for just one year. Then, Kanghan Electronics will be mine." 

A contract marriage with a set expiration date. Haebom knew that an even more hellish future awaited her after the contract with him ended. Even so, for the very first time in her life, she found something she desperately desired. 

"I want to marry you, Mr. Kang Ihan." 

Even if it's salvation that lasts only a year. She wants to experience the spring he offers, just for once.

title: Oneul Menu Chucheon Jom!

unknown.title: Please Recommend Something for Today's Menu!

description:
Tae-Ho and Ji-Ho, siblings who suddenly lost both their parents when their father murdered their mother. Faced with an overwhelming reality, Tae-Ho decides to become a master of home-cooked meals for his younger brother, Ji-Ho. 

Social worker Kyu-Jin, known for being a picky eater, hears about their situation and decides he cannot simply leave them to fend for themselves. He visits their home to try to connect them with a shelter, only to find himself completely helpless against Tae-Ho’s home-cooked meal offensive. 

Ji-Ho, who finds strength just by thinking about food no matter how hard things get, and Tae-Ho, who hones his cooking skills for Ji-Ho’s sake— Kyu-Jin finds that Tae-Ho’s food suits his taste exceptionally well. Before they knew it, the three of them began to resemble a “family,” for whom eating together no longer felt awkward. And they even made new friends through “Seum,” a child welfare organization established for the children of inmates. Mealtimes, which Tae-Ho and Ji-Ho used to spend alone, or sometimes in lonely solitude, have now become the most joyful part of their day.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

unknown.title: あなたの推し騎士に投票してください！

description:
I was South Korea’s top idol survival show producer—until I opened my eyes and found myself reincarnated as Edith, the only daughter of the new emperor who had overthrown a tyrant through revolution. Using the knowledge from my previous life and alchemy, I somehow managed to help bring the tyrant down. But what awaited us afterward was an imperial family whose reputation among the people had already hit rock bottom. So, to resuscitate the dying imperial family, I decided to pull out my secret weapon: a survival competition where the people themselves vote to select the Empire’s finest order of knights! Drawing on the skills from my past life, I rolled up my sleeves, ready to manufacture drama with some ruthless evil editing. 

But… what is this? Who are these contestants with such perfectly compelling stories that they don’t even need evil editing? Unmatched visuals that require no editing, emotional backstories impossible to watch without tears, and on top of that, intense bromance chemistry that constantly blurs the line between friendship and love! Maybe this… could become an even bigger hit than the masterpiece I created in my previous life!

A fierce survival competition featuring knights determined to capture your heart.

title: Ipsuri Seuchimyeon Inyeon
description:
An ambassador arrives from the Eastern Empire: Yeo Ho-gyeol, the 13th Prince, with sharp, well-defined features and a tall stature.     
Greeting him is Infineta, the universally beloved Princess of the Western Empire. 

The moment they first meet, Ho-gyeol realizes that her special power is his only lifeline, while Infineta feels her heart burning with a passionate fervor for the very first time. 

With their mutual interests aligning, the marriage proceeds at lightning speed.     
Thinking that all that was left was happiness after successfully getting through their first night together...    
Infineta discovers that Ho-gyeol never actually spent their wedding night with her, and that he only married her to use her for 'a certain power.' 

Ho-gyeol needs Infineta's power, and Infineta wants his heart.    
Who will manage to conquer the other first and achieve their goal? 

"You, you're so used to this. Where did you practice?"    
"How could I not know anything about my wife?"

title: Gaeneun Juini Piryohada
description:
[This is the story of a woman transported into a BL novel, where she must survive by dealing with the most dangerous character in the entire world—a deadly quest to win her new master's favor before he decides to kill her!] 

Erabelle Vermillion is a low-ranking countess with a huge secret: she isn't from this world. She was once an ordinary reader who somehow became trapped inside the world of a novel known for its violence, brutality, and graphic content. 

For eight years, Erabelle has hidden herself from the main cast while desperately searching for a way back to her own world. 

Just when she finally finds a temporal rift that could take her home, she's caught by the most dangerous character in the novel: Dejev Abaknis. Dejev is infamous for his violence and is destined to become the cause of the horrific slaughter that takes place in the novel's final chapters. 

Certain that he'll kill her, Erabelle desperately pleads for her life and offers to become his servant instead. Now, trapped in this mad world with the novel's most dangerous man as her master, Erabelle must do everything she can to earn his favor and stay alive. 

Let's plunge into this chaotic world and hope our protagonist can survive long enough to escape... or perhaps become the one person her dangerous master can't let go.

[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3498026965)

description:
Soyeong, an illegitimate princess who has spent her life being mistreated in the imperial palace because of her birth, suffers from a chronic illness. Led by her older brother, the Third Prince, she is practically forced into a marriage with the Seo family. But her married life is troubled from the very beginning. Her husband, Seo Jin, completely ignores her, leaving Soyeong to endure the cold and lonely mansion on her own. Then, one day, he suddenly changes. His once-frigid gaze becomes gentle, and the hands that used to pull away from her begin to seek her out with an almost obsessive persistence. 

“Don’t be afraid, my lady. I am your husband, after all.” 

Suspicious of this unfamiliar transformation, Soyeong begins searching for the truth. As she investigates, she finds herself drawn deeper and deeper into the hidden secrets surrounding her husband and the Seo family...

description:
Hae-Jo is a hybrid of a poisonous bird, the Jimsae. Due to an unfortunate accident caused by his poisonous feathers, he was banished to the human world and is only allowed to return to the divine realm during his mating season. However, because he is a hybrid of a poisonous bird, no one will mate with him, leaving him a lifelong bachelor and a virgin. Hearing that hybrids have lifespans as short as humans', Hae-Jo gives up on mating and attempts to steal an egg. However, failing to steal even that properly, he is about to give up when he discovers something that looks like an egg…! But it was not an egg; it was the sealed power of the Wolf King. The King's power belongs to the King. To reclaim the power Hae-Jo has swallowed, some radical wolves insist that he must be killed immediately. However, Hae-Jo makes a bold declaration that he will return the King's power through 'sleeping together'…!

description:
Erica is a force of nature on the battlefield, an S-Class Mercenary whose overwhelming skill leaves only awe and destruction in her wake, yet she cannot shake her equally lethal shadow: Chaud. Driven by a maddening intensity, he corners her with a fierce demand.

 “Let’s form a fixed Pair. Just thinking about you with some other pathetic loser makes me so mad I can’t sleep.” 

Matching in age, unmatched in skill, and sharing the same delightfully unhinged recklessness, the two forge a chaotic but undeniable bond. Yet as they survive battle after battle, Chaud’s loyalty warps into a desperate obsession.

 “There’s something I really want,” he warns her one evening, his gaze locked dangerously onto hers. “If someone else takes it from me, it’s going to be a war.” 

Oblivious to the fact that she is his ultimate prize, Erica brushes the threat aside. It’s only years later, backed into a corner by his simmering devotion, that she finally realizes the terrifying depth of the trap she walked into. 

“I told you, Erica,” he murmurs softly. “If someone else takes it from me… it’s war.” 

What begins as a chaotic survival tale between two overpowered mercenaries explodes into a high-stakes battle romance… a journey of mutual salvation forged in blood, steel, and a dangerously sweet obsession.

description:
Hyeon-Sung, having suffered a severe injury and lost even the spirits that had always been by his side, is left with nothing but low-level spirits incapable of combat. Forced to retire due to the aftereffects of his injury, Hyeon-Sung returns to farming at the urging of a childhood friend.

Wild-grown food, contaminated by the miasma emitted by monsters, has become completely inedible, so the price of food is now determined by its taste. No matter how high-grade the food is, it’s so tasteless compared to what he used to eat that it’s not even worth comparing…

 *“Why are the crops I’ve grown so delicious?!”*

When the crops grown in Hyeon-Sung’s field began to reveal the “true flavor” that had been lost, his quiet rural life was turned upside down. From the nation’s top hunter to a high-ranking Special Operations officer, and even the top stars of the three major entertainment agencies! National-level heavyweights who’ve never known fear begin flocking to this remote corner of the countryside!!

title: The Rumors Subject

unknown.title: The One at the Center of the Rumors

description:
["The shaman's daughter in Class 2-1 supposedly sees ghosts."]

Eun-ha was at the center of all sorts of rumors—dubbed the shaman's daughter and a girl with a foul temper. There was not a single adult to look after her.

Then there was Gye Cheon-young, the only person who called her by her proper name rather than labeling her the shaman's daughter. A national Taekwondo athlete loved by everyone, he was the polar opposite of her.

"If you don't have a girlfriend, will you go out with me?"

A confession made on a whim. Cheon-young readily accepted.

Although their romance started haphazardly, it was happy. It was overwhelmingly heart-fluttering and cozy.

However, malicious rumors continued to follow Eun-ha, and an exhausted Eun-ha eventually left Cheon-young behind.

10 years later. They unexpectedly reunite in a place free from the labels of being a shaman's daughter or any other stigmas.

"I've been looking for you for a long time, Eun-ha."

Their unfinished first love had never truly stopped.

"You started it first 10 years ago. This time, it's my turn. So you better be prepared."

“Clover, iz okay.” 

Even so, Clover never let herself be discouraged. Because someday, her dad would come and get her. 

[August 2. Sunny. Auntie got mad again. She told me not to tell Dad.]

title: Namja Eodiseo Mannayo?
description:
Kim Mi-Yeong, a single woman in her mid-thirties, was enjoying a comfortable, carefree single life when she suddenly felt left behind by the news of her friends’ weddings. Filled with a sense of crisis that she might end up dying alone if things continued this way, Mi-Yeong sets out to find a husband, trying everything from dating apps and blind dates to clubs and matchmaking agencies. However, opportunities to meet new men are few and far between, and when she does manage to meet someone, she tends to notice their flaws first. Yet she can’t bring herself to compromise easily just for the sake of marriage. 

*“Will I ever meet a good man to marry?”
“But what exactly is a ‘good man’?”
“How do I want to live my life?”*

Amid countless questions about marriage, this is the story of her journey to find the ending that’s right for her.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: Cheon Gyejeol
description:
*“When the real and the fake meet, can love become real?”*

It had been two years since I started living as a fake rich person. I’d rather be envied for being rich than looked down on for being poor. It was a lie that would be fine as long as I didn’t get caught. But, of all people, a boy who seemed capable of seeing right through that lie ended up sitting behind me. Overwhelming wealth, overwhelming indifference. Sin Jae-Eon, the grandson of a real chaebol family. She had planned to use him as a shield. But at some point, he stopped being a shield and became a source of warmth.

*“I really like you, Lee Ji-Seo. I like you.”*

The straightforward confession of a boy who has nothing to gain and nothing to lose. And a girl who’s afraid to even open her heart, not knowing when it will all be exposed. How long can I, the fake one, hold out in front of him, the real one? Before the first season passes, what will the two of them become to each other?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The Beautiful Warmonger.

These terrifying nicknames belong to Carlos, the Grand Duke of the northern Duchy of Paitan, a man feared by all.

When he, who had sworn never to marry her, changed his mind, Margaret believed it was her destiny.

However, upon discovering the secret he had been hiding, “Because it’s a fate that has bound us for a very long time.”

She realized she had been mistaken.    
Everything had been wrong from the beginning.    
From the very start, their marriage was destined to end in death.
