title: Heogi
description:
The man appeared a few days after the loan sharks had come and gone. They said that if you failed to repay your debt, they would chase you down until they could rip your guts out. And yet the man who had taken over my space as if it belonged to him acted completely at ease. “You look exactly the same. Like you were copied straight out of a machine.” I had no idea what he was talking about. He looked suspicious and dangerous, but all I could do was glare at him sharply. “Don’t worry. You won’t be able to pay that money back anyway. So just open your mouth.” Perhaps he found it amusing that his presence had made me too uncomfortable to wash or even eat, because he smiled as he held out some food to me. After several exhausting days, fatigue and hunger hit me all at once. “You should eat something too.” “I’m going to eat something else. Have you ever slept with a man?” The man revealed his desire without the slightest hesitation. That smile looked far too innocent for someone who could say something like that. I hated to admit it, but he looked unbelievably kind. “Because you’re pretty. Because you’re so damn pretty.” With a hand burning with heat, the man gently stroked my face. The temperature inside the room, already thick with the humidity of monsoon season, began to rise in an instant. The summer I was twenty-three, filled with an emptiness that felt as though it could never be satisfied. That was how the rainy season began.

title: Omanhan Nampyeonui Gwontae
description:
“You don’t love me anymore.” 

That was the conclusion Hyeon Ijun, Lee Sehui’s husband, had reached. He had kept his eyes on Sehui from the very moment she was born, and although he had claimed so much of her as his—including many of her firsts—he was never truly satisfied. 

“Darling, s-stop. The children are here……” 

Boredom. That was how Ijun chose to define what he was feeling. After all, there was no reason someone like him could possibly be starved for something as trivial as affection. 

Therefore, this had to be what people commonly called the seven-year itch—the inevitable weariness that settled into a marriage. And so, hoping to restore their relationship and return to the days when Sehui had been desperate for his attention, Ijun decided to take a step away from her. description:
A weaponsmith who works himself to death, shaving away at his own life to forge weapons for the Hero’s party. That foolish man is my father. The moment I learned what the future held, I decided to take drastic measures to save him. And that meant sabotaging his business! “Oh nooo, how can such a magnificent sword fail to cut even one soft little potato?!” “What? This time it can’t even slice through ham!” “There’s no waaay a sword made by Mr. Royz could be this terriiible!” The sabotage was a complete success. But I couldn’t stop there. So when the heroes came looking for my father, I politely told them, “Neil Royz? I don’t know anyone by that name. I live only with my mom.” Sorry, Dad. My plan worked perfectly. Not a single customer came to my father’s weapon shop, and the heroes stopped asking him to forge swords for them. I thought all that was left was for Dad and me to live happily together… But then— “Little one, how old are you turning this year?” Out of nowhere, the most powerful duke in the Empire claims that I’m his granddaughter. What on earth is going on? What is happening to me?
Source: MU

The Abandoned Maid of the Grand Duke's Household

description:
“Shall I kill him? Your husband.” 

*** 

I possessed Julie, a maid in a romance fantasy novel. Of all people, I turned out to be the mother of the female protagonist, who gets pregnant with the Grand Duke's child, is abandoned, and dies on the streets. I hate affairs, and I hate dying a miserable death even more. I thought I could live a normal life as long as I avoided the Grand Duke. 

“It's merely a strategic marriage. Trust me, Julie.” 

As if ten years of putting up an iron wall wasn't enough, he keeps acting like this even after I'm married. Eventually, with the Grand Duchess's permission, I married a sincere stablehand. I thought I had finally escaped the death ending— On my wedding day, the one who came to find me wasn't the groom, but the Grand Duke. 

*** 

“Let go of me. My husband is waiting.” 

“A husband you haven't even spent your wedding night with?” 

“He's still my husband, the one I had a wedding ceremony with.” 

All the warmth vanished from the normally affectionate man's face. 

“Was that bastard the reason you've been rejecting me all this time?” 

Wait, wasn't this the man who was supposed to abandon me? I avoided him so I wouldn't get abandoned, but now he won't let me go. There was nothing about this man's obsession in the novel I read?!

description:
[Is XX with a non-human Yeti possible?]

Waking up from a nap on the bus after work just like any other day, I found myself in the middle of a massive snowfield.

A bleak and pure white winter landscape where snowflakes flutter and hands and feet freeze.

Staring blankly at that distant and surreal snowfield, Suna thought:    
'I've... been stranded!'   

She tried writing SOS in the snow and searched desperately for human traces, but what appeared was not a rescue helicopter.   

They were typical monsters of another world, yet bizarre monsters Suna had never imagined. The monsters each had their own species names, but to Suna, they all looked the same.

'Green monster (Goblin)! Stone monster (Golem)! Wolf monster (Direwolf)!'

However, there was one creature too ambiguous to be called a monster that caught Suna's eye. A creature too big to be human, and too human to be a monster.   
Thump, thump, thump, thump.   
Giant feet unlike a human's, a huge body covered in white fur, and blue skin.   
Walking with heavy, rhythmic steps, that was a monster from folklore—a Yeti.   
Suna looked up at him under the massive silhouette resembling a great mountain.   
There are no humans in this world. But there is a humanoid type like the Yeti, Utoom.   
'That's enough then.'  
Suna decided to accept it.

title: The Guide
description:
*Mr. Cha, I have a crush on you.*

Cha Ji-Won, director of Gallery Hwadam. With his exceptional talent and striking good looks, this man, who seems perfect to anyone who sees him, possesses one secret ability. He can see ghosts and draw their portraits to banish them. One day, after banishing a tormenting spirit with a single drawing as he usually does, Ji-Won is dragged to “Jungcheon” for sending the deceased away without following proper procedures. And there, in Jungcheon, the place where the dead are judged, he meets Ga-On, the ruler of Jungcheon. 

At first, it was a matter of pride. He thought it was simply curiosity toward a transcendent being who wouldn’t even glance his way. It was a feeling too complex to call mere determination, but he had no other way to explain it. Yeah, that’s how it was at first… but why does she look so beautiful to me now? 

Ga-on, who has spent her entire life judging the dead as part of her millennia-long mission, has only 30 years left. In her life, where she has never even tasted a simple Americano, Cha Ji-Won, the first man to treat her with warmth, begins to make his way into her heart. The two of them judge and save the dead together. Will they be able to save each other?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Laniakea was ready to pack her bags the moment another prince took the throne. But when all three rival princes die overnight, Hyperion claims the crown—and returns to the palace with a serious demand.

**"Let us hurry and sign the divorce agreement,"** she says.
**"A son or a daughter doesn't matter, let us hurry and have an heir,"** he replies.

Wait... weren't we on the same page?!

description:
[If more than three people doubt the death, the soul will be saved.]

I was betrayed by my uncle and my trusted lover and stood in front of the guillotine.

Even if I die, I swore to avenge my enemies and sharpened my blade of revenge.

“I, Cassion Richte Petrora, cannot accept Diana’s death.”

I had my head decapitated, and when I opened my eyes, I returned to my 13 years old self.

I made a vow as I shed tears of joy.

“The revenge I was planning to avenge in hell, I will give it to you in this lifetime.”

***

The only thing I had was money, and what I didn’t have was people.

So, I gathered people with money…

“Let’s poison him, cough. You have a lot of money, so you can handle that, right?”

Said the twisted sickly prince,

“Are you sure you want to save the body? Can I open it?”

Said the doctor who was crazy about anatomy,

“Just give me the information. If you could do that, I will do anything for you.”

Said the clueless aunt who had no sense of justice and conscience, Zoe, in the presence of information.

“Be my disciple.”

Even the best con artist on the continent wanted to make me his disciple.

Somehow, I only gathered people who smelled like villains.

Will I be able to get my revenge on my enemies safely?

Then comes a freezing winter night when he finds a barefoot child wandering the streets. Taking the boy in, Hajun discovers a horrifying truth: the child is the worshipped deity of the very cult that ruined his family. From eating her first burger to seeing the world for the very first time, she's determined to make the most of her life. As the attacks grow more relentless, William realizes the girl he's protecting may be the most valuable target on Earth. Now, a retired assassin and a stubborn young girl must race across the country in search of her missing father while staying one step ahead of the powerful forces closing in on them. But why is the entire world hunting Ko?

My heart grew urgent because the man just stared at me intently without saying a word.    

A-And.... I, I can't even speak p-properly.... and my foot……."   

I was going to tell him that I also limp.

"Are you saying you're defective?"

At the word 'defective,' I clamped my mouth shut and lowered my head.    
Now that he knew everything, the man would look at me with a scornful face.

"It doesn't matter. I'm a bastard with plenty of defects myself."

I slowly raised my eyes, which had been cast downward.   
I thought he would surely be angry, but he wasn't.
MActing as if it didn't matter, the man went on.

***

"Shall I really put a leash on you?"

Even when he reached out and wrapped his hand around my neck, I couldn't budge and froze.    
As if it would snap with just a little pressure from his hand, I could only tremble with my eyes.   
The hand that was gripping my neck moved up and grabbed my chin.   
Catching the back of my neck, he pulled me forward forcefully.

"Jae-i. We need to go home."

If I moved even just a little, I would be embraced in his arms.

However, putting strength into my feet, I stood and slowly shook my head.

…I will only…. leave blemishes on Kang-heon.

"It's no use crying, you know."

description:

Though René had a humble appearance, blind and covered in burn scars, she took Vera in with a heart more kind and selfless than anyone else’s. description:

Under the Demon King’s command, I set out across a desolate land. Just as I was about to fall into the clutches of a monster, the one who came to my rescue was none other than a wandering knight. 

“What are you? The Demon King’s succubus?”

title: The Plushie's Favorite Human
description:
Lee Rowoon is a college student cursed to transform into a doll every night at midnight. Her dream is to break the curse, live a normal life, and grow closer to Ha Hyun, the upperclassman who happens to be her ideal type. 

One day, Rowoon unexpectedly runs into Dae Gilseong, an older acquaintance she once trusted and admired more than anyone else. But Gilseong is none other than the person who stole the "Key of Blessing" ten years ago, a magical object that protected her from the curse and held the only means of breaking it. Furious, Rowoon chases after him, but just as she is about to tumble down the stairs, Gilseong tries to save her, and the two accidentally share a kiss. 

Unfortunately, the unexpected side effect leaves Rowoon permanently trapped in her doll form, unable to return to normal. Soon afterward, Rowoon's uncle, a wizard, arrives to take care of her and demands that Gilseong return the key. Gilseong reveals a gemstone embedded in his chest and explains that the key was mysteriously absorbed into his body one day. He has spent the past ten years searching for Rowoon, hoping to reverse what happened. With the key now fused to Gilseong, the only way Rowoon can temporarily maintain her human form is by kissing him. Left with no other choice, she begins secretly living with him. 

Eventually, the condition for completely breaking the curse is revealed. Gilseong, who has become the key itself, and Rowoon, the girl under the curse, must share a kiss while their feelings are perfectly aligned. Whether those feelings are born of hatred... or love.

I sometimes look back and think.   

Lee Shin.  

What if I had made a different choice on the day I first met him?  

"Hello?"  

What if, instead of greeting him like that, I had pretended not to know him? If I had done that, wouldn't Lee Seung-woo still be alive?   

No, to be more precise, could I have avoided being murdered by him? Even while harboring such doubts, I couldn't bring myself to ask him. It wasn't because I lacked courage. 

"Today is your ovulation day, noona. The kind of day you like it rough."

I liked having sex with him. I loved the coercive, explosive sex so much that I tore down the walls of doubt with my own hands. Believing that there was no way he could have murdered my ex-boyfriend, I willingly laid beneath him.

description:
I worked myself to death in 21st-century South Korea and died from overwork.

When I opened my eyes, I had been reincarnated as the precious youngest daughter of a Count’s family—the kind of family you’d only ever see in a fantasy novel. I had money, a home, and a loving family to rely on. My only goal for this life was to live comfortably, spending my days doing nothing but playing, eating, and enjoying myself!

…Or so I thought.

“I heard that you were the one who wrote this proposal and these plans, Young Lady.”

“I wasn’t.”

“I heard everything from the Count. Your work is more impressive than anything his retainers have produced in all their years of service.”

I had only helped out a little because looking at my overworked father broke my heart…… And somehow, my efforts caught the Northern Grand Duke’s attention.

“I want to hire you.”

What did he just say to someone who died from overwork in her previous life? Hire me? A company? Labor?!

“I want you.”

“I’m sorry, but I’m not interested in a career in the slightest. My goal is to marry someone I love and live happily ever after.”

Not this time. Absolutely not. Never, ever, ever would I die from overwork again!

“I see…”

“Yes. Well then, I shall take my leave—”

“Then marrying me should do.”

“Pardon?”

And so begins Countess Aerin’s arduous quest to become a wealthy stay-at-home wife, along with Northern Grand Duke Kael’s pursuit of the young lady—a courtship that looks suspiciously like headhunting…….

description:
Level 1 Hunter Koutake Takeru gains a mere hundred-thousandth of the experience points he would get from even the weakest goblin. Undeterred by this hopeless reality, he spent ten years single-mindedly hunting goblins. Just as he’s about to level up, he unexpectedly encountered a boss monster. After a fierce battle, he maxed out his experience points. However, for some reason, he still didn't level up. In a world governed by the laws of the “Nameverse”, soulmates are marked by the literal spelling of their partner's name upon their skin.

When the elite, third-generation chaebol heir Woo Baek-yeon and the easygoing former bodyguard Jung Han-kyung suddenly manifest each other's names, the intense sensory rush triggers an explosive public incident at a crowded wedding hall. A video of their dramatic, passionate first kiss instantly goes viral, forcing the cold and fiercely private Baek-yeon to present Han-kyung with a three-year marriage contract to appease his family and control the media frenzy. The duo crafts a fabricated backstory claiming to be old high school friends who reunited through destiny, plunging the straight-identified Han-kyung into a domestic layout with a drop-dead gorgeous man.

As they transition from formal partners to roommates navigating the slip of casual boundaries, Baek-yeon's icy exterior melts into a fiercely coy, flustered devotion, while Han-kyung's playful teasing gives way to a deeper affection that threatens to permanently rewrite the boundaries of their temporary arrangement.

description:
I learned far too early in life that things rarely go as planned.

“Here, hold your twentieth younger sibling.”


Lurubel Derams is the eldest daughter of the squirrel family, renowned for their loving and harmonious household.

She has more younger siblings than links in a string of sausages, a father who works himself to the bone as a butler, and a mother who can barely manage to put work aside despite her frail health.

But even when life lets her down, the eldest daughter of the Derams family still heads to work today.

“You’ve heard the rumors, haven’t you? They say Duke Kun Russell Blantiger was granted his title because his eldest brother died on the battlefield. I heard he later adopted his only nephew. That must be why he’s looking for a tutor.”

Duke Kun Russell Blantiger. The man known as the King of the North.

He was an aristocrat among aristocrats, wielding the formidable power of a grand ducal house.

“Oh, but how could an inadequate teacher like me possibly work in such a strict household?”

If she carelessly stepped into a place like that, she might never make it out in one piece. She needed to be cautious.

“They say the salary is fifty gold coins.”

“Where do I need to go?”

“Have you ever considered getting married?”

“I have absolutely no intention of getting married. I want to keep working at Blan Castle for a very, very long time!!”

“Then how about getting engaged to me?”

Pardon? What did I just hear?

description:
Sarah Rosenbaum sold her country in her previous life.

Not just once, but twice.

The first time was to the Empire from the kingdom she was born into, and the second time was that Empire to the revolutionaries.

Knowing this, anyone would blame her, asking why she would sell her own country if there was nothing else to sell.

But that’s something only those who don’t know her circumstances would say.

She sold it because she could, and she had no regrets about that choice.

“Because of you, the world above is a complete mess right now.”

However, if she couldn’t reincarnate because of that, the story changes.

She endured the terrible fires of hell for 300 years, waiting for the day she could reincarnate, only to be met with the thunderous judgment that she still had a long way to go.

“Go up to the surface right now and restore the fates that have been twisted and will be twisted because of you.”

So she readily accepted the god’s proposal.

It was a flawed mission missing the when, where, what, and how, but that didn’t matter.

Even though it was a somewhat reckless resurrection, Sarah was deeply grateful to the god who gave her the chance.

Until she met that man.

“Fancy seeing this face here.”

Cold eyes looking down at her as if in disbelief.

Enoch Soser, the hero who had once plunged a holy sword into Sarah’s heart, moved only his lips to express his thoughts.

“It’s unlucky.”

description:
Nami had been sold for money.

She possessed absolutely nothing, except for a rather indecent fortune that supposedly destined her to ensnare a man and never let him go.

And so, she was welcomed as a precious bride, someone capable of keeping a firm hold on the damn family's only heir in three generations—a man who, despite being well past the age to settle down, seemed far more interested in spilling blood than sowing his seed.

They expected Nami to bear him a strong, healthy son.

However, Hyuk, the man who had become her husband, agreed to marry only because his parents pleaded with him, promising that once the wedding was over, he could return to the battlefield and do as he pleased, even if it meant dying there.

And so, immediately after the ceremony, he fled into the night and returned to war without even consummating their marriage.

Unable to fulfill the purpose for which she had been brought into the household, Nami soon became an unwanted burden.

Even so, she wholeheartedly accepted the man she had seen only once, on their wedding day, as her husband.

She quietly cherished and respected him, secretly blushing as she nurtured the innocent feelings of her first love.

But when that man finally returned three years later, he didn't even remember her…

"Oh, aren't you that broodmare?"

Nami had always endured hardship and mistreatment with a smile, believing it was simply her fate.

Even when the servants insulted her and called her a "damn bitch," her expression remained calm, never once showing the slightest sign of defeat.

But that day, for the very first time, her unwavering composure shattered.
